mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals labor market strength, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth >5% and FEDFUNDS decline >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: Interaction effect does not produce statistically significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During an early monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising but below 5%), the delayed impact on equity discount rates generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% in early tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor market activity (PAYEMS increasing over time) signals strong employment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS shows a sustained upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the industrial production index (INDPRO above 115) signals supply-side strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 115.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE <4.5%) combined with strong labor demand (PAYEMS >138,000) creates a dual positive signal for corporate performance, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect does not produce statistically significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, low inflation (CPIAUCSL <2%) and low unemployment (UNRATE <4.5%) signal sustainable growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansions when both CPIAUCSL <2% and UNRATE <4.5%.
